questions.question:
**Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question that follows.**

The numbers in different sections indicate themnumber of persons who can drive different vehicles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19923c613b431a30497c6ec495ec28a85c45f59a0bb0b524b5f219631b66290e.png] 

What is the difference between the number of persons who can drive all the three vehicles and that of persons who can drive any two of these vehicles?
questions.solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91df53576d418dc3768b61afb3dfa3d22b67c4e81e069d8e87e8a309daf2f8c.png] 

The number of persons who can drive all the three vehicles = **6**

Persons who can drive any two of these vehicles = 8 + 7 + 12 =** 27**

Thus, the difference between the number of persons who can drive all the three vehicles and that of persons who can drive any two of these vehicles = 27 - 6 = **21**

Hence, the correct answer is **"21".**

⇒ 7 × 5 + __**30 ÷ 6**__ - 4 = ?

⇒ ? = __**7 ×**____** 5**__ + 5 - 4 

⇒ ? =__** 35 + 5**__ - 4 

⇒ ? = __**40 - 4**__ = 36

Hence, the correct answer is "36".

questions.question: 7 is related to 40 by certain logic. Following the same logic, 5 is related to 16. To which of the following is 9 related, following the same logic? (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits, E.g., 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying/etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)² - 9 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 7 : 40

⇒ 7² - 9 = 49 - 9 = 40.

For, 5 : 16

⇒ 5² - 9 = 25 - 9 = 16.

Similarly, for 9 ∶ ?

**⇒ 9² - 9 = 81 - 9 = 72.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Which is the number on the face opposite the face containing 5?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403a8e3f5768b2d090b6f1b7292ca1b1544c89ab0a1c35fc7c4dbc8e9624f31c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b43fef2b3672e4630d4b42c33354ed831abb8034b548d2455ba0fc6d9b0e39b.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of '5', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7d1615b36a96d95612ca66b82eb80357665335de925b060bf8000d2f2155625.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92584d043aeeea3a5cb69e920d50f02f41a974279d5a3d4a7d98f276a2f07df3.png] 

From both dices, 2 is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

3 is opposite to 4.

So, 1 will be opposite to 5.

Hence, the correct answer is "1".

questions.question:
Three of the following numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

**Logic: Numbers are prime numbers except only one number.**

1) 829: Prime number (divisible only by 1 and 829)

2) 821: Prime number (divisible only by 1 and 821)

3) 643: Prime number (divisible only by 1 and 643)

**4) 237: Not prime number (divisible by 1, 3, 79 and 237)**

Hence, the correct answer is **"237".**
